note: EU ETS SAF allowances (Directive 2003/87/EC Art. 3c(6), inserted by Directive (EU) 2023/958). Rates transcribed from the Official Journal text. Pathway categories for ATJ and FT depend on feedstock and are assumptions.

legal_basis.name: Directive (EU) 2023/958, Article 3c(6) of Directive 2003/87/EC
legal_basis.basis: Share of the remaining price differential between fossil kerosene and the eligible fuel, after the carbon-price incentive; allocated yearly and ex post, reduced uniformly if demand exceeds the reserve.

hefa.note: UCO / tallow are RED Annex IX Part B, not advanced biofuels.

atj.note: Assumes crop-based ethanol; Annex IX Part A feedstock would qualify for 70 %.

ft.note: Assumes Annex IX Part A residues (e.g. forestry, agricultural waste).

ptl.note: Synthetic kerosene from renewable hydrogen is an RFNBO.
